mapper.select: SELECT SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR,end_time,start_time)) AS duration, SUM(real_fee) AS income, COUNT(id) AS orders FROM tb_order WHERE driver_id = #{driverId} AND date = CURRENT_DATE
